integrity: Exact finite-field counting and a standalone modular irreducibility certificate were executed from the packaged files; no external independent scientific audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The L-polynomial and Newton polygon are determined for one curve over F5. The Jacobian is proved simple over F5, not over the algebraic closure; no generic-family prescription. The source already establishes the automorphism group and genus.
title: A simple nonordinary Jacobian from a minimal-automorphism Artin–Schreier curve
